column1: # Semantic function renames (Phase C). Applied to source by tools/apply_names.py and
# consumed at BUILD time by tools/ccproc.py, which keeps the original
# .text.func_<addr> section name (so the SORT_BY_NAME link order is unchanged) and
# emits a `func_<addr> = <new_name>` symbol alias (so any un-renamed asm/C caller
# still resolves). Both are stripped by objcopy => the byte-exact binary is unaffected.
#   old_name : original symbol, must equal func_<ADDR>
#   new_name : readable camelCase C identifier (never starts with func_)
#   evidence : non-empty justification (config/knowledge/*.json, adrando anchor, idiom)
# Names are conservative: they describe the verified mechanical operation, not guessed
# gameplay semantics. Confidence noted in evidence where medium.

knowledge/func_8004DC14.json: allocates a fixed 0x100-byte object via func_8004B404, forwarding a1-a3 through (medium)

The code delegates to the same glyph decoder used by the complete positioned-text builder, then copies its four rectangle bytes. No item record or category is read and no caller establishes an item role. Keep the independently bound glyph-rectangle operation.

knowledge/func_8004E5A0.json: formats value into buf right-justified in width columns, space-padded (func_8004E57C) then reverses
knowledge/func_8004E5E8.json: sibling of func_8004E5A0 with the pad char hardcoded to '0' (0x30)
knowledge/func_8004E634.json: converts an unsigned int to a decimal ASCII string (0xCCCCCCCD /10 magic-multiply idiom, utoa)
knowledge/func_8004E928.json: allocates a 0x100 buffer and fills it by parsing string a0 via func_8004E298, unless a0 is blank (medium)
knowledge/func_8005D550.json: stores a value into u16 table D_80079958.ptr[a0], optionally right-shifted by D_80079980[0] when a2!=0 (medium)
